# Russia

`jmfsb_faction_russia`

2040 Russia: Aegis's Russian army (uniform_ru) - its woodland (taiga) soldiers and loadouts, their sheets in e22's colours - with the base game's CSAT vehicles and the old jmfsb Russia's specials, painted in e22's colours by the camo pipeline. FA tier 3 ammunition. Generated by `tools/gen_mod_factions.py`.
